comment: An ellipsis the block container draws after an inline-block that is positioned (relative) or a stacking context (opacity, transform) is painted with the line's inline content, as Chromium paints it: the inline-block and its child (blue, overflowing over the ellipsis) are painted later, over it; a z-index -1 one is painted before the block's content, under it. The ellipsis has the block's colour (red), the text a span's.
